_note: COUNTERFACTUAL SENSITIVITY for the verdict surface. Each pair is one case and its minimal edit: exactly one decisive fact is inverted and everything else is held fixed. A system that is reading the evidence changes its answer; a system that is pattern-matching the prompt, the compound name or the shape of the package does not.
_whyThisIsTheStrongestVerdictTEST: Accuracy on a fixed set can be scored well by a model that never reads the findings at all - four of nine constructed cases are `cannot_conclude`, so a system that always abstains scores 44%, and one that has learned 'oncology package with a margin means advance' can do better still without reasoning. Sensitivity cannot be gamed that way: the two halves of a pair are nearly identical strings, so the only way to answer both correctly is to have read the one field that differs. This is the standard counterfactual / minimal-pair design used in behavioural testing of NLP systems (CheckList, Ribeiro et al. 2020; contrast sets, Gardner et al. 2020).
_scoring: A pair PASSES only when both halves are answered correctly. Getting the base right and the flip wrong is the diagnostic failure - it means the original answer was reached without the fact that was supposed to drive it.

rules.name: Human relevance
rules.statement: Human-cell evidence defeats animal in vivo evidence when the question is human hepatotoxicity.

rules.name: Exposure relevance
rules.statement: A finding at an exposure far above the projected human Cmax carries less weight than one at or near it.

rules.name: Reversibility
rules.statement: Damage that reverses on withdrawal is weaker evidence of a safety concern than damage that persists.

pairs.edit: The single human-cell finding is inverted from toxic to safe. Nothing else changes.
pairs.tests: R1. If the verdict does not move, the human finding was not what drove it.

pairs.edit: The same toxic finding moves from 1.1x projected human Cmax to 60x. Only the multiple changes.
pairs.tests: R2. Damage at sixty times clinical exposure is a different claim from damage at clinical exposure, and a system that ignores the number treats them alike.
